introduction: Hello! My name is Samuel Bernardes, I am 23 years old and I am a Software Engineer passionate about technology. I am currently studying Computer Engineering at CEFET-MG and hold a technical degree in Computer Science from IFMG. Since 2023 I have been working at DataViva, where I help build the new version of the platform end-to-end: from AWS cloud architecture and Python (Spark) data pipelines to Full Stack development with React and FastAPI. I also work as a consultant at Tavus Data, building a complete E-learning ecosystem with Node.js, Express, React and TypeScript. I am driven by the desire to keep learning and evolve professionally. I am a communicative person, love working in a team and believe that collaboration is essential to achieving exceptional results. I am always looking for new challenges to apply my technical skills and contribute to innovative projects.
